description: 各维度分别占比（CTE 模式1）
notes: 必须使用CTE隔离分组与全局聚合
sql_template: WITH grouped AS (SELECT {{dimension}}, {{metric}} AS part_value FROM {{table}} WHERE {{conditions}} GROUP BY {{dimension}}), total AS (SELECT {{metric}} AS total_value FROM {{table}} WHERE {{conditions}}) SELECT g.{{dimension}}, g.part_value, t.total_value, ROUND(g.part_value * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_value, 0), 2) AS ratio FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY g.part_value DESC

WITH part AS (SELECT {{metric}} AS part_value FROM {{table}} WHERE {{conditions}} AND {{numerator_filter}}), total AS (SELECT {{metric}} AS total_value FROM {{table}} WHERE {{conditions}}) SELECT p.part_value, t.total_value, ROUND(p.part_value * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_value, 0), 2) AS ratio FROM part p CROSS JOIN total t

description: TOP N 占比（CTE 模式3）
sql_template: WITH ranked AS (SELECT {{dimension}}, {{metric}} AS part_value FROM {{table}} WHERE {{conditions}} GROUP BY {{dimension}} ORDER BY part_value DESC LIMIT {{N}}), total AS (SELECT {{metric}} AS total_value FROM {{table}} WHERE {{conditions}}) SELECT r.{{dimension}}, r.part_value, t.total_value, ROUND(r.part_value * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_value, 0), 2) AS ratio FROM ranked r CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY r.part_value DESC
